name: SEC Cross Country Championships
headline: SEC Cross Country Championships
summary: Final: Alabama won both SEC titles. The No. 4 Crimson Tide men scored 37 points to beat No. 7 Arkansas (76) and No. 9 Florida (82), with Florida's Kelvin Cheruiyot winning the 8K in 22:03.1. The women's team also won, scoring 48 to Florida's 80 with South Carolina third at 110, as Alabama's Caren Kiplagat took the 6K in 18:46.5, 1.4 seconds ahead of Arkansas' Isca Chelangat.
